records.context: :class:`HintBar` keeps four visible lines at a fixed height. Longer help can be scrolled within that space while the pointer is over a widget. On pointer leave, it restores the default message only when that widget's text is still displayed, avoiding an intermediate reset between adjacent controls.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.hint_bar#1
records.source: :class:`HintBar` keeps four visible lines at a fixed height. Longer help can be scrolled within that space while the pointer is over a widget. On pointer leave, it restores the default message only when that widget's text is still displayed, avoiding an intermediate reset between adjacent controls.
records.translation: :class:`HintBar` 는 고정 높이에 네 줄을 표시합니다. 포인터가 컨트롤 위에 있는 동안 긴 도움말을 이 영역 안에서 스크롤할 수 있습니다. 포인터가 떠나면 해당 컨트롤의 텍스트가 여전히 표시되는 경우에만 기본 메시지를 복원하여 인접한 컨트롤 사이에서 중간 초기화가 발생하지 않도록 합니다.

records.context: A fixed help strip and the register of what each widget should say.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.hint_bar.HintBar#0
records.source: A fixed help strip and the register of what each widget should say.
records.translation: 고정 높이의 도움말 영역과 각 컨트롤이 표시해야 할 텍스트의 등록부입니다.

records.context: Four lines stay visible: moving between controls cannot change the dialog's layout. Longer or translated help scrolls inside the strip without losing its full text or accessible description.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.hint_bar.HintBar#4
records.source: Four lines stay visible: moving between controls cannot change the dialog's layout. Longer or translated help scrolls inside the strip without losing its full text or accessible description.
records.translation: 네 줄이 계속 표시됩니다. 컨트롤 사이를 이동해도 대화 상자의 레이아웃은 바뀌지 않습니다. 길거나 번역된 도움말은 영역 안에서 스크롤되며 전체 텍스트와 접근성 설명은 유지됩니다.

records.context: Show all help in the fixed strip, scrolling when it exceeds four lines.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.hint_bar.HintBar.setText#0
records.source: Show all help in the fixed strip, scrolling when it exceeds four lines.
records.translation: 고정 높이의 영역에 모든 도움말을 표시하고 네 줄을 넘으면 스크롤합니다.

records.context: Restore a saved height after the Preferences layout is measured.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.hint_bar.HintBar.showEvent#0
records.source: Restore a saved height after the Preferences layout is measured.
records.translation: 환경 설정 레이아웃을 측정한 뒤 저장된 높이를 복원합니다.

records.context: Return the complete sentence currently shown in the strip.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.hint_bar.HintBar.text#0
records.source: Return the complete sentence currently shown in the strip.
records.translation: 현재 도움말 영역에 표시되는 전체 문장을 반환합니다.
